lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso; spacing is approximately equidistant with a slight increase in gap width toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line terminates at mid-torso height; the two posterior-most lines are fragmented into vertical series of spots rather than continuous segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Four high-contrast white spots located on the posterior haunch; two larger primary spots positioned above two smaller auxiliary spots.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two primary upper spots exhibit a near-horizontal geometric alignment across the upper thigh.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with a backward vector of approximately 45 degrees from the frontal bone, transitioning to an upward vertical trajectory near the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 3.5 times the pixel width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping comprises approximately 12-15% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white facial chevron between the orbital regions, white mandibular spots, and a dark shaggy mane along the ventral neck and chest.
